metaTitle: Custom Unisex Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex lapel pins for your team or event. Perfect for corporate branding and recognition. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Unisex lapel pins are designed to suit any wearer, making them ideal for corporate uniforms, event badges, or employee recognition programs. Whether you need hard enamel pins for a polished look or soft enamel for detailed logos, these pins offer versatile decoration options like offset printing or die-struck metal. Choose from gold, silver, or black nickel plating to match your brand colors. Custom unisex lapel pins ensure a consistent, professional appearance across your entire team without worrying about gendered sizing or styling.
heroAltText: Custom unisex lapel pins in hard enamel with butterfly clutch backing, featuring a corporate logo on a silver nickel finish.
